title: Run packaged AgentCore service recovery smoke
purpose: Prove the packaged runtime can execute approved and denied service recovery through generic AgentCore.
scope: Run service recovery approved path from packaged or staged runtime artifacts.
Run service recovery denied path and confirm no effect is prepared.
Capture runtime audit projection for both paths.
Fail if the old dedicated workflow path bypasses AgentCore.
acceptance_criteria: Approved path reaches CommitSealed or equivalent successful runtime terminal state.
Denied path records PolicyEvaluated without EffectPrepared.
Audit projection explains plan, policy, approval/denial, effect, verification, and terminal state.
No raw secrets appear in smoke evidence.
verification: Run approved service recovery CLI smoke.
Run denied service recovery CLI smoke.
Run audit projection over smoke logs.
risk_notes: A bootable image without packaged runtime smoke can still be missing the real AgentCore path.
implementation_steps: Identify the packaged or staged agentd invocation path.
Run approved and denied service recovery smokes.
Capture and redact audit projection evidence.
Record whether the smoke ran from host target, staged runtime, or full image.
failure_modes: Smoke uses old workflow wrapper without proving AgentCore.
Denied path prepares or observes an effect.
Audit projection omits policy or verification context.

verification_matrix.expected: Generic AgentCore service recovery tests pass

blocked_until: Packaged runtime smoke has approved and denied evidence.

completed_evidence.execution_surface: host cargo binary against staged Alpha rootfs runtime contracts
